briefdescription.para: Computes the projection (clique expansion) of an undirected hypergraph.

detaileddescription.para: Projects the hypergraph onto a standard undirected graph. Each hyperedge in the hypergraph is expanded into a clique (a fully connected subgraph) connecting all of its incident vertices in the resulting graph. Duplicate edges generated by multiple hyperedges overlapping on the same vertices are collapsed into a single edge.

blockquote.para: If the requested target graph G satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the gl::to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target standard graph type to construct. Must satisfy c_undirected_graph.

simplesect.para: A standard undirected graph representing the projection.

briefdescription.para: Computes the projection of a BF-directed hypergraph.

detaileddescription.para: Projects the hypergraph onto a standard directed graph. For each hyperedge, directed edges are created from every vertex in the hyperedge's tail (source) to every vertex in its head (destination). Duplicate edges generated by multiple hyperedges overlapping on the same vertices are collapsed into a single edge.

blockquote.para: If the requested target graph G satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the gl::to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target standard graph type to construct. Must satisfy c_directed_graph.

simplesect.para: A standard directed graph representing the projection.

briefdescription.para: Computes the bipartite incidence graph representation of an undirected hypergraph.

detaileddescription.para: Converts the hypergraph into a standard bipartite graph where both the original vertices and the original hyperedges are represented as standard graph vertices. Undirected edges are created between a vertex node and a hyperedge node if they are incident.

blockquote.para: To ensure uniqueness in the resulting graph, the IDs of the hyperedge nodes are shifted by h.n_vertices(). For example, hyperedge ID 0 becomes vertex ID h.n_vertices() + 0 in the resulting graph.

If the requested target graph G satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the gl::to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target standard graph type to construct. Must satisfy c_undirected_graph.

simplesect.para: A standard undirected bipartite graph representing the incidence structure.

briefdescription.para: Computes the bipartite incidence graph representation of a BF-directed hypergraph.

detaileddescription.para: Converts the hypergraph into a standard bipartite directed graph. Directed edges are created from original tail vertex nodes to the hyperedge nodes, and from the hyperedge nodes to the original head vertex nodes.

blockquote.para: To ensure uniqueness in the resulting graph, the IDs of the hyperedge nodes are shifted by h.n_vertices(). For example, hyperedge ID 0 becomes vertex ID h.n_vertices() + 0 in the resulting graph.

If the requested target graph G satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the gl::to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target standard graph type to construct. Must satisfy c_directed_graph.

simplesect.para: A standard directed bipartite graph representing the incidence structure.

briefdescription.para: Fundamental hypergraph data structures, element descriptors, and configuration tags.

detaileddescription.para: This group establishes the primary user interface for the HGL module, centered around the highly configurable hypergraph class. It provides the core data types, such as vertex and hyperedge descriptors, required to safely navigate and manipulate graph elements.

Furthermore, this module defines the declarative tags (e.g., directedness and backend implementation types) that dictate both the behavioral semantics and the underlying memory layout of the instantiated hypergraphs.
